name: Philcon
blurb: The Philadelphia Science Fiction Society's literary SF, fantasy and horror convention, marking its 90th anniversary in 2026 at a Cherry Hill, NJ hotel.

picks: Author, All the Birds in the Sky

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Philcon 2026 will take place on November 20-22, 2026 at the Doubletree by Hilton, 2349 Marlton Pike West, Cherry Hill, NJ'

notes: The guests page cleanly lists 4 named guests: Principal Speaker, Artist Guest, Musical Guest of Honor, and a special guest for the Eric Flint's 1632 Minicon track held within Philcon. Each has a bio on the page, but the extractor's captured text is truncated, so Known For is condensed from the first clause of each bio. Sarah Pinsker's card captured only an alt-text label ('Musical Guest of Honor Headshot') with no separate bio text, so Known For uses that label directly; she is also a Hugo/Nebula-winning SF author, but the con specifically bills her for music this year, so cat is music to match. Donato Giancola is a narrative/SFF fine-art and book-cover painter rather than a comic-book artist, so cat is 'other' (no better fit in the allowed list).
